errName: Enter a name for this counter.
errRenameSame: Enter a different name for this counter.
errAddUser: Enter the viewer whose value you want to set.
errAddCommand: Enter the command or reward this value belongs to.
resetBody: This clears every stored value for "{name}". Commands that bump it start again from zero.
description: Named tallies your commands and channel-point rewards bump: deaths, wins, hugs, anything.
degraded: Counters are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
scopeCommand: Per command or reward, all users pooled
scopeViewerCommand: Per user, per command or reward
scopeHint: Bump it from a command response with {counter:name}, from a reward on the Channel Points page, or with !counter add.
scopeLocked: The scope is fixed once created. To change it, delete the counter and recreate it.
emptySub: Create one above, or just use {counter:name} in a command response. It appears here on first use.
pickerEmpty: No counters yet. Create one below.
deleteBody: “{name}” and all its stored values are removed. Commands that bump it will recreate it from zero. This cannot be undone.
entriesEmpty: Nothing recorded yet for this counter.
errUnknownUser: No Twitch user with that name.
entryDeleteBody: The stored value for {name} is removed. A future bump recreates it from zero. This cannot be undone.
discardBody: You have unsaved changes to this counter. Discard them?
